verified.project_tests_run: No unit tests exist for the object-storage endpoint at the pinned commit. The hidden suites (9 security, 8 functional) exercise the in-store and outside-location paths offline at every covered interface. The project's e2e object-storage tests need a running gateway and ClickHouse and were not run.

wrong_fix_catalogue.crash_as_refusal: n/a: refusals are ordinary errors and the tests assert no object bytes are returned or persisted; a panic or a 500 refusal that serves nothing is indistinguishable from a correct refusal and cannot pass by leaking.
wrong_fix_catalogue.one_role_or_direction: n/a: the product has no roles, peers or transfer directions on this path; every caller is treated identically.
wrong_fix_catalogue.reads_only: n/a: the flaw is a read; there is no write counterpart whose guard could be omitted, and every tested surface is a read.
wrong_fix_catalogue.check_after_adjustment: n/a: object keys are parsed and rejected, never normalised into a different value before the guard.
wrong_fix_catalogue.malformed_identity: n/a: the identity is a structured storage location parsed by serde and object_store::Path; malformed values are rejected before any guard runs.
wrong_fix_catalogue.missing_authority: n/a: there is no authority/secret lookup that could fail open; the only condition is whether a configured store exists.
